title: 第8章  有仇报仇，有怨报怨！
content_zh:
“小弟弟，药液配制得如何？”
刚走出炼丹室，一袭酒红色旗袍的蓝媚儿就迎了上来，笑靥如花。
“多亏了贵楼提供的炼丹室，在下感激不尽。”
方玄没有承认，也没有否认。
“为客人提供方便，满足客人的需求，一向是我天宝楼的宗旨。”
蓝媚儿掩嘴一笑，说道：“不知道小弟弟还有其他的需求吗？”
方玄摇头道：“虽然这天宝楼好东西很多，我这种普通人可买不起。”
“小弟弟真会说笑。”
蓝媚儿说道：“连苏家人都不放在眼里，小弟弟可不是什么普通人。”
方玄不想纠缠这个话题，说道：“麻烦蓝管事算算多少元石吧。”
蓝媚儿好似有所准备，说道：“一瓶气血丹，一瓶元心丹，再加上几副药材，就收两千元石好了。”
“两千元石？”
方玄眉头一皱。
倒不是觉得贵。
而是太便宜了。
一瓶气血丹里面，共有三枚。
总价值就需要一千五百元石之多。
元心丹的价值也相差不大。
更别说，炼制龙骨灵液的药材，最起码也要一千元石左右。
这些东西加起来，最低也要四千元石。

蓝媚儿却只收两千元石，可以说是半卖半送。
“要是小弟弟觉得贵，姐姐还可以给你打个折哦。”
蓝媚儿靠近方玄两步，吐气如兰，眉眼如画。
“不用不用。”
方玄连忙后退一步，说道：“只是占了贵楼这么大的便宜，在下心里实在有些过意不去。”
蓝媚儿不以为意的说道：“就当是感谢小弟弟为我天宝楼侍女出手的报酬吧。”
“既然如此，那在下就在此谢过蓝管事了。”
蓝媚儿都这样说了，方玄也不矫情，当场交付了两千元石。
“对了。”
完成交易，蓝媚儿低声道：“那苏扬一看就不是什么大度之人，你今日得罪了他，当心被他报复。”
我就怕他不来。
心中冷笑一声，方玄不露声色，说道：“多谢蓝管事提醒，那在下就先行告辞了。”
目送方玄离去，蓝媚儿美眸一闪。
“小姐，需要派人去查一下吗？”
那名青衣侍女走了过来，小声开口。
“查什么？”
蓝媚儿瞥了对方一眼，打趣道：“还是说，人家为你出了头，你这小妮子就对人家芳心暗许了？”
青衣侍女却被吓了一大跳，连忙跪在地上。
“奴婢不敢，还请小姐恕罪。”
蓝媚儿翻了个白眼：“起来吧。真是无趣。”

说罢，蓝媚儿转身离去。
......
“呼。”
看了眼身后的天宝楼，方玄轻吐一口浊气。
拍了拍腰上的储物袋，左右观察了一眼，方玄这才快步离开。
如今气血丹和龙骨灵液已经到手，他需要回去闭关，尽快提升实力。
而方玄并不知道，在他离开没多久，两道身影悄然跟随在后。
此时，天色暗淡，已近夜幕。
方玄脚步不紧不慢，穿梭在小巷之中。
直到......
前面没路了。
方玄转身，看着堵在巷口的两道身影，神情平静。
“苏家的人？”
闻言，其中一人冷笑道：“小子倒是有点眼力劲，既然认出来了，那就跟我们走一趟吧，我家少爷要见你。”
“我要是不去呢？”
方玄反问。
“这可由不得你。”
那人嗤笑一声，体内气血运转，五指如钩，直奔方玄而去。
看其气息，已然达到了造血境八重境。
“得罪了我家少爷还想溜？可能吗！”

话音落下之时，他已经出现在方玄面前。
凌厉的爪风，直接扣向方玄的肩膀，准备将方玄擒住。
不等对方的手爪落在肩上，方玄眼中寒芒一闪，出拳如电，后发先至的击中对方胸膛。
“噗！”
这一拳，直接将对方击飞出去，人未落地，一口鲜血就喷了出来。
“咚！”
等这人落在地上之时，又喷出一口鲜血，满脸骇然的看着方玄。
仅仅一招，他就落败了？
“咦？倒是有几分实力。”
另外一人先是一惊，随即狞笑道：“可惜，纵然你有三头六臂，今日也插翅难飞！”
说罢，他脚掌一跺地面，人已经如同猎豹般冲向方玄。
拳风如火，爆裂至极的轰向方玄脑袋。
他的修为比先前那人更强，已经达到了造血境九重。
出手更快，也更为狠辣。
但方玄却是面无表情，不闪不避的一掌迎了上来。
“嘭！”
拳掌相击，前者瞬间惨叫一声，一条手臂已经变成麻花，痛得五官扭曲。
“你......”
他无比惊恐的看着方玄，内心一片震撼。
而方玄并未就此停手，一拳废掉对方之后，再次欺身而上。

五指紧握成拳，瞬间击中对方的胸膛。
对方自知不敌方玄，连忙抽身后退。
但方玄的速度，远超他的想象，以迅雷不及掩耳之势，直接一拳砸在他的胸膛之上。
“咔嚓！”
这一拳，当场将对方砸得胸膛塌陷，骨骼断裂，口鼻之中有鲜血喷出。
他轰然倒地，瞪大双眼，却是死不瞑目。
而整个过程，方玄身上，并无半点气血外泄。
靠的，仅是惊人的速度，和强悍的肉身力量。
获九帝传承，凝混沌圣体，方玄的肉身，已经远超同境武者。
只凭肉身力量，方玄就不惧任何造血境武者。
击杀了一人，方玄看向剩下的那名苏家武者。
但后者却是吓得瞪大眼珠，满脸难以置信。
“你......你是方玄？”
他声音尖厉，如同见鬼一般：“你没有死？”
方玄这才意识到，原来是刚才出手的时候，脸上的面皮掉落，露出本来的面目。
“看来，我没死你们很多人都很失望啊。”
方玄扯掉垂落的面皮，露齿一笑。
只是这个笑容，落在此人眼中，却比恶魔还要恐怖。
“你要做什么？”
此人连连后退，说道：“别杀我，我也只是听命行事而已。”

“方玄，我警告你别乱来！”
见方玄不为所动，此人厉声道：“我可是苏扬少爷的人，你要是杀了我，少爷绝对不会放过你的！”
“他不放过我？我还不会放过他呢！”
方玄快步上前，一脚踹碎对方的膝盖。
对方扑通一声跪在地上，放声惨叫。
“方玄，方少爷，我错了，我真的知道错了。”
这人痛哭流涕，哀求道：“别杀我，求您高抬贵手，把我放了吧。”
方玄一把抓住对方的头发，语气淡漠如寒冰。
“你不是知道错了，你是知道自己要死了。”
说罢，方玄五指用力，直接拧断对方的脖子。
连杀了两人，方玄神情没有半点波动。
这两人，作为苏扬的狗，这三年来，可没少欺他辱他。
他方玄道心蒙尘三年，被人耻笑欺辱三年。
苏清瑶赵擎苍，废他武脉，夺他道体，将他打入万丈深渊。
既然他大难不死，携九帝神通归来。
那他就要有仇报仇，有怨报怨！
看着地上的两具尸体，方玄眼中寒芒愈发浓郁。
“这，只是开始......”
......
“哥，你总算回来了！”

刚回到小院，妹妹方柔顿时扑了上来，满脸担心，生怕方玄又出事了。
察觉到妹妹的担忧和紧张，方玄宠溺的拍了拍妹妹的脑袋，说道：“哥答应你，从今往后，绝对不会再让你担心。”
“嗯嗯。”
方柔声音带着哭腔。
她自幼和哥哥相依为命，将哥哥视为她唯一的依靠。
这次方玄遭遇意外，差点回不来，对她来说，就像天塌了一样。
即便方玄只离开几个时辰，她也担惊受怕不已。
方玄好一阵安抚，妹妹方柔才放松下来。
“对了小妹，这个给你。”
方玄将一瓶丹药递给妹妹，说道：“你体内伤势虽然不重，但若是不能及时调理，势必会留下重大隐患，这元心丹恰好可以助你梳理内腑，修复伤势。”
“元心丹？哥，这太贵重了。”
方柔虽然还没开启武脉，但自幼耳濡目染，也知道元心丹价值不菲。
“你马上就要和方霄决战，怎么能在我身上花这些冤枉钱呢？”
方柔希望方玄，把元心丹换成自己修炼所需的资源。
“给自己妹妹花钱，怎么能说是冤枉呢？”
方玄拍了拍方柔的小脑袋，说道：“对哥来说，你比这元心丹重要百倍千倍。”
“可是......”
方柔还要拒绝，方玄便说道：“行了，给你你就拿着吧。等你调理好伤势，也该着手准备觉醒武脉了。”
“觉醒武脉？”
方柔闻言顿时一喜，满脸期待的说道：“哥，我真的可以吗？可是大长老他们......”

“放心吧，哥说你可以你就可以。”
方玄语气坚定的说道：“谁敢阻拦，哥就杀谁，天王老子也阻止不了！”
任何人，在十二岁之后就可以觉醒武脉。
妹妹如今已经十四岁，按道理早已可以进行武脉觉醒。
但因为方玄痴傻三年，导致妹妹不受待见，方家连她的武脉觉醒资格都给取消了。
方玄早就决定好，等解决了方霄，就给妹妹觉醒武脉，成为一名武者。
谁敢阻拦，他就宰谁！
“谢谢哥哥，我一定会努力的！”
九州大陆，谁不想觉醒武脉，成为一名武者，受人敬仰。
而她一旦成为武者，就能保护好哥哥了。
content_en:
"Little brother, how is the preparation of the medicine?"
As soon as she walked out of the alchemy room, Lan Meier, wearing a burgundy cheongsam, came up to her with a smile as bright as a flower.
"Thanks to the alchemy room provided by your building, I am very grateful."
Fang Xuan neither admitted nor denied.
"Providing convenience to guests and meeting their needs has always been our purpose at Tianbao Tower."
Lan Meier covered her mouth with a smile and said, "I wonder if my little brother has any other needs?"
Fang Xuan shook his head and said: "Although there are many good things in Tianbao Tower, ordinary people like me can't afford them."
"My little brother is really good at joking."
Lan Meier said: "Even the Su family doesn't look down on him. My little brother is not an ordinary person."
Fang Xuan didn't want to dwell on this topic, so he said, "Can I please calculate the number of Yuan Stones, Manager Lan?"
Lan Meier seemed to be prepared and said: "One bottle of Qi Blood Pill, one bottle of Yuan Xin Pill, plus a few pairs of medicinal materials, we will collect two thousand Yuan Stones."
"Two thousand yuan stones?"
Fang Xuan frowned.
Not that it feels expensive.
But it's too cheap.
There are three Qi and Blood Pills in a bottle.
The total value is as much as fifteen hundred yuan.
The value of Yuan Xin Dan is not much different.
Not to mention, the medicinal materials used to refine Dragon Bone Spiritual Liquid cost at least about a thousand Yuan Stone.
The total cost of these things is at least four thousand yuan stones.
Lan Meier only accepted two thousand yuan of stone, which could be said to be half sale and half free.
"If my little brother thinks it's expensive, my sister can give you a discount."
Lan Meier took two steps closer to Fang Xuan, her breath was as blue as blue, and her eyebrows were like paintings.
"No, no, no."
Fang Xuan quickly took a step back and said, "I just took advantage of Guilou, so I feel a little sorry."
Lan Meier said nonchalantly: "Just think of it as a reward for thanking my little brother for helping my maid in Tianbao Tower."
"In that case, I would like to thank Manager Lan here."
Lan Meier said so, and Fang Xuan didn't show any pretense and handed over two thousand yuan stones on the spot.
"Right."
After completing the transaction, Lan Meier whispered: "Su Yang is not a generous person at first glance. You have offended him today, be careful of his revenge."
I'm afraid he won't come.
With a sneer in his heart, Fang Xuan said calmly, "Thank you very much, Manager Lan, for reminding me. I'll take my leave first."
Watching Fang Xuan leave, Lan Meier's beautiful eyes flashed.
"Miss, do you need to send someone to check?"
The maid in blue came over and spoke in a low voice.
"What to check?"
Lan Mei'er glanced at the other person and joked: "Or, just because they stood up for you, you, little girl, secretly made a promise to them?"
The maid in green was frightened and quickly knelt on the ground.
"I don't dare, please forgive me, young lady."
Lan Meier rolled her eyes: "Get up. It's so boring."
After saying that, Lan Meier turned and left.
...
"Huh."
Glancing at Tianbao Tower behind him, Fang Xuan let out a sigh of relief.
After patting the storage bag on his waist and looking around, Fang Xuan quickly left.
Now that he has obtained the Qi-Blood Pill and Dragon Bone Spirit Liquid, he needs to go back to retreat and improve his strength as soon as possible.
But Fang Xuan didn't know that not long after he left, two figures followed quietly.
At this time, the sky was dark and it was almost night.
Fang Xuan walked leisurely and slowly through the alleys.
Until...
There is no road ahead.
Fang Xuan turned around and looked at the two figures blocking the alley with a calm expression.
"People from the Su family?"
Hearing this, one of them sneered and said: "You are quite discerning. Now that you recognize him, come with us. My young master wants to see you."
"What if I don't go?"
Fang Xuan asked back.
"It's not up to you."
The man sneered, his energy and blood circulated in his body, his fingers were like hooks, and he headed straight towards Fang Xuan.
Judging from his aura, he has already reached the eighth level of hematopoietic realm.
"I offended my young masterStill want to run away? Is it possible! "
When he finished speaking, he had already appeared in front of Fang Xuan.
The sharp claw wind clasped directly at Fang Xuan's shoulder, preparing to capture Fang Xuan.
Before the opponent's claws landed on his shoulders, Fang Xuan's eyes flashed coldly, and he punched like lightning, hitting the opponent's chest first and last.
"Poof! "
This punch directly knocked the opponent away, and a mouthful of blood spurted out before the person hit the ground.
“Boom! "
When the man fell to the ground, he spurted out another mouthful of blood and looked at Fang Xuan with a horrified face.
He was defeated with just one move?
"Eh? It does have some strength. "
The other person was startled at first, and then said with a ferocious smile: "It's a pity that even if you have three heads and six arms, you can't fly today! "
After saying that, he stomped the ground with the sole of his foot, and he rushed towards Fang Xuan like a cheetah.
The fist wind was like fire, exploding to the extreme and hit Fang Xuan's head.
His cultivation level is stronger than that of the previous person, and he has reached the ninth level of blood-making realm.
The attacks are faster and more ruthless.
But Fang Xuan had no expression on his face, and he met him with a palm without dodging.
“Bang! "
The fists and palms hit each other, and the former screamed instantly, one of his arms had turned into a twist, and his facial features were twisted in pain.
"You..."
He looked at Fang Xuan with great horror, his heart was shocked.
But Fang Xuan didn't stop there. After destroying the opponent with one punch, he bullied him again.
The five fingers clenched into a fist and hit the opponent's chest instantly.
The opponent knew that he was no match for Fang Xuan, so he quickly retreated.
But Fang Xuan's speed was far beyond his imagination. With lightning speed, he punched him directly in the chest.
“Crack! "
With this punch, the opponent's chest collapsed on the spot, his bones were broken, and blood spurted out from his mouth and nose.
He fell to the ground with a crash, his eyes widened, but he refused to rest in silence.
During the whole process, not a single bit of Qi or blood leaked from Fang Xuan's body.
Relying only on amazing speed and strong physical strength.
Obtaining the inheritance from the Nine Emperors and condensing the Chaos Holy Body, Fang Xuan's physical body has far surpassed that of warriors in the same realm.
With only physical strength, Fang Xuan is not afraid of any blood-making realm warrior.
After killing one person, Fang Xuan looked at the remaining Su family warrior.
But the latter's eyes widened in fright, with disbelief on his face.
"You...are you Fang Xuan? "
His voice was sharp, as if he had seen a ghost: "You're not dead? "
Only then did Fang Xuan realize that it was when he took action just now that the skin on his face fell off, revealing his true face.
“It seems that many of you are disappointed that I’m not dead. "
Fang Xuan pulled off the hanging face and grinned.
It's just that this smile, in this man's eyes, is more terrifying than the devil.
"What are you going to do? "
The man backed away repeatedly and said, "Don't kill me, I'm just following orders. "
"Fang Xuan, I warn you not to mess around! "
Seeing that Fang Xuan was unmoved, the man said sternly: "I belong to Master Su Yang. If you kill me, Master will never let you go! "
"He won't let me go? I won't let him go yet! "
Fang Xuan stepped forward quickly and kicked the opponent's knee to pieces.
The other party fell to his knees on the ground with a plop and screamed loudly.
"Fang Xuan, Master Fang, I was wrong, I really know I was wrong. "
The man cried bitterly and begged: "Don't kill me, please be noble and let me go." "
Fang Xuan grabbed the other party's hair, his tone as cold as ice.
"You didn't know you were wrong, you knew you were going to die. "
After saying that, Fang Xuan used five fingers to twist the opponent's neck directly.
After killing two people in a row, Fang Xuan's expression did not change at all.
These two people, as Su Yang's dogs, have often bullied and humiliated him in the past three years.
Fang Xuandao's heart was in ruins for three years, and he was ridiculed and humiliated for three years.
Su Qingyao and Zhao Qingcang destroyed his martial arts, took away his Taoist body, and drove him into the abyss.
Since he survived the catastrophe, he returned with the magical power of the Nine Emperors.
Then he will have revenge and revenge.!
Looking at the two corpses on the ground, Fang Xuan's eyes grew colder.
"This is just the beginning..."
...
"Brother, you are finally back!"
As soon as he returned to the small courtyard, his younger sister Fang Rou rushed towards him, her face full of worry, fearing that something might happen to Fang Xuan again.
Sensing his sister's worry and nervousness, Fang Xuan patted his sister's head lovingly and said, "Brother, I promise you that from now on, I will never let you worry again."
"Yeah."
Fang Rou's voice was filled with tears.
She has been dependent on her brother since she was a child, and she regards him as her only support.
This time Fang Xuan encountered an accident and almost couldn't come back. To her, it was like the sky had fallen.
Even though Fang Xuan was only gone for a few hours, she was still worried.
After Fang Xuan comforted him for a while, his sister Fang Rou relaxed.
"By the way, little sister, this is for you."
Fang Xuan handed a bottle of elixir to his sister and said: "Although the injury in your body is not serious, if it cannot be treated in time, it will definitely leave major hidden dangers. This Yuanxin elixir can just help you sort out your internal organs and repair the injury."
"Yuanxin Dan? Brother, this is too expensive."
Although Fang Rou has not yet opened her martial arts veins, she has been exposed to it since she was a child and knows that the Yuanxin Pill is valuable.
"You are about to have a decisive battle with Fang Xiao, how can you spend all this unjust money on me?"
Fang Rou hopes that Fang Xuan will exchange the Yuanxin Pill for the resources he needs for his cultivation.
"How can you say it's unfair to spend money on your sister?"
Fang Xuan patted Fang Rou's little head and said, "To me, you are a hundred times more important than this Yuan Xin Pill."
"But..."
Fang Rou still wanted to refuse, so Fang Xuan said, "Okay, just take it. Once you've taken care of your injuries, it's time to prepare to awaken your martial arts."
"Awakening martial arts?"
Fang Rou was immediately happy when she heard this, and said with expectation: "Brother, can I really do it? But the Great Elder and the others..."
"Don't worry, if I say you can do it, you can do it."
Fang Xuan said firmly: "I will kill anyone who dares to stop me, even the King of Heaven can't stop me!"
Anyone can awaken martial arts after the age of twelve.
My sister is now fourteen years old, so it stands to reason that she can already awaken her martial arts.
But because Fang Xuan had been stupid for three years, his sister was not welcomed, and the Fang family even canceled her qualification for martial arts awakening.
Fang Xuan had already decided that after solving Fang Xiao, he would awaken his sister's martial veins and become a warrior.
He will kill anyone who dares to stop him!
"Thank you brother, I will definitely work hard!"
In the Jiuzhou Continent, who doesn’t want to awaken the martial arts, become a warrior, and be respected by others?
And once she becomes a warrior, she can protect her brother.
